Brief: Tell me about the Antikythera mechanism and how it was decoded. — about Discovery

Kept:
1. On 17 May 1902, archaeologist Valerios Stais, together with his cousin, the Greek politician Spyridon Stais, found one of the pieces of rock had a gear wheel embedded in it.
2. He initially believed that it was an astronomical clock, but most scholars considered the device to be prochronistic, too complex to have been constructed during the same period as the other pieces that had been discovered.
3. The German philologist Albert Rehm became interested in the device and was the first to propose that it was an astronomical calculator.
